verdict.rationale: Reclaim.ai is a SaaS calendar-automation product, so offering official SDKs is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an official SDK, client library, or developer API. Probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404. The help-center llms.txt is a docs-discoverability aid, not an SDK. Task integrations (Todoist, Asana, etc.) and the Slack and Calendar add-ons are adjacent features and earn no credit.
